edits.new: Apply each restriction to the entity or role it constrains, and propose a concrete candidate outside it. Test whether it preserves every child requirement, including necessary implications.
edits.old: Apply each restriction to the entity or role it constrains, and construct a concrete case outside it while preserving every child requirement, even if a necessary implication may exclude the case.

edits.new: If no such restriction applies, or its case is inadmissible or covered, continue testing other parent requirements, prioritizing further qualifications absent from the child's explicit wording before shared conditions.
edits.old: If it is inadmissible or covered, continue testing other parent requirements, prioritizing further qualifications absent from the child's explicit wording before shared conditions.
